history.requirements: Clamp finite numbers to inclusive lower/upper bounds; reversed bounds throw RangeError. Include boundary, interior, negative and error cases.

files.content: export function clamp(x,a,b){if(a>b)throw new RangeError();return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));}

tests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {clamp} from '../src/clamp.js';test('boundary interior negative error',()=>{assert.equal(clamp(-4,-2,3),-2);assert.equal(clamp(4,-2,3),3);assert.equal(clamp(0,-2,3),0);assert.throws(()=>clamp(0,2,1),RangeError);});

fixtures.requirements: normalize accepts a string, trims leading/trailing whitespace, lowercases letters, preserves internal whitespace, and returns empty for all-whitespace strings. Non-string inputs throw TypeError. Use independent exact expectations.

files.content: export function normalize(s){if(typeof s!=='string')throw new TypeError();return s.trim().toLowerCase();}

referenceTests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {normalize} from '../src/normalize.js';test('trim lowercase internal empty type',()=>{assert.equal(normalize('  HeLLo  '),'hello');assert.equal(normalize(' A  B '),'a  b');assert.equal(normalize('  '),'');assert.throws(()=>normalize(2),TypeError);});

files.content: export function normalize(s){if(typeof s!=='string')throw new TypeError();return s.toLowerCase();}
export function normalize(s){if(typeof s!=='string')throw new TypeError();return s.trim();}

fixtures.requirements: unique takes an array of numbers or strings and returns a new array containing only the first occurrence of each distinct value, in original order. Number 1 and string "1" remain distinct. Do not mutate the input. Empty arrays return empty. Non-array inputs throw TypeError.

files.content: export function unique(xs){if(!Array.isArray(xs))throw new TypeError();return [...new Set(xs)];}

referenceTests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {unique} from '../src/unique.js';test('stable distinct immutable empty type',()=>{const input=[3,1,3,'1',1];assert.deepEqual(unique(input),[3,1,'1']);assert.deepEqual(input,[3,1,3,'1',1]);assert.deepEqual(unique([]),[]);assert.throws(()=>unique(null),TypeError);});

files.content: export function unique(xs){if(!Array.isArray(xs))throw new TypeError();return [...new Set(xs.map(String))];}
export function unique(xs){if(!Array.isArray(xs))throw new TypeError();return [...new Set(xs)].reverse();}
